content_blocks.text: The night was thick with silence, save for the distant hoot of an owl. Sarah stood at the edge of the forest, her breath visible in the cold air. She clutched the old map in her hand, its faded ink barely legible. The wind whispered through the trees, carrying with it the scent of pine and earth. With a deep breath, she stepped into the darkness, the map guiding her through the shadows as if by magic.
